title: Detecting Silent Action-Interface Mismatch with Calibrated Relational World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A robot action can satisfy shape and range constraints yet carry the wrong semantics: axes may be permuted, signs inverted, rotations rescaled, or gripper polarity reversed. We study learned state-action-effect relations as offline contracts for detecting these mismatches and ranking their likely fields. Clean held-out transitions calibrate alarms; a fixed inverse vocabulary supports closed-set localization. On ten LIBERO Spatial tasks comprising 432 source episodes, a capacity-controlled comparison at 2.5% empirical clean false-positive rate gives 46.1% recall for a ridge forward residual, 61.0% for a four-component joint Gaussian mixture, and 65.7% for the exact conditional of that same mixture. The joint score retains a 14.9 percentage-point advantage over ridge, while conditioning improves recall by a further 4.7 points. Joint scoring instead has higher localization: 95.8% versus 94.6%. These matched-rate comparisons are retrospect

translated_title: 使用校准的关系世界模型检测静默的动作接口失配
translated_abstract: 机器人的动作即使满足形状和范围约束，仍可能携带错误的语义：坐标轴可能被置换、符号可能被反转、旋转可能被重新缩放，或夹爪极性可能被颠倒。我们研究学习到的状态-动作-效果关系，将其作为离线契约来检测这些失配并对其可能涉及的字段进行排序。干净的保留转换数据用于校准警报；固定的反向词汇表支持闭集定位。在包含432个源片段的十个LIBERO Spatial任务上，在2.5%经验干净假阳性率下进行的容量受控比较显示：岭回归前向残差的召回率为46.1%，四分量联合高斯混合模型为61.0%，而同一混合模型的精确条件分布达到65.7%。联合评分比岭回归保持14.9个百分点的优势，而条件化使召回率进一步提高4.7个百分点。联合评分则在定位方面表现更高：95.8%对94.6%。
tldr: 该论文提出将学习到的状态-动作-效果关系作为离线契约，利用校准的联合高斯混合评分及其条件分布来检测机器人动作接口中的静默语义失配，在LIBERO任务上达到65.7%的召回率和95.8%的失配字段定位准确率。
en_tdlr: Proposes using learned state-action-effect relations as offline contracts with calibrated joint Gaussian mixture scoring and its exact conditional to detect silent semantic mismatches in robot action interfaces, achieving 65.7% recall and 95.8% mismatch-field localization accuracy on LIBERO tasks.
